requiredContent.finding: Own target/click accepts the optional fourth requiredContent argument and embeds its literal in the same generated target expression. The content check is made after unique visible-target admission and therefore participates in the initial read, post-hover read, every original stability sample and the final direct target read. Incoming target/click has no such argument.

savedSettings.finding: Own retains exact model/control identity, valid expanded state, finite positive rectangle, the captured dialog's own non-running/non-paused/non-pending animations, and three consecutive equal eligible samples with reset on missing/ineligible/changed state. Its original30s/100ms loop and single subsequent settings click remain. Incoming uses only unique row plus id/expanded and contains none of this admission block. BOOT helper is unrelated to saved settings and cannot preserve that block automatically.

navigationObserver.finding: Own observes eligible pointerdown/pointerup/click card events, captures a canonical encoded host-team target, and reads own-data descriptors from the callable Zustand store into the focused pane/tab projection (up to4 panes/128 tabs). Its five tests cover getter-zero failures, bounded schema, non-card handling and callback retention. Incoming observes trusted click only, uses flattened openTabs/activeTabId (up to64), direct property accesses and a different target/key/schema/bound projection. Its one test has materially different expected fields and does not replace the five own tests. Preserve ours unless a separate observer redesign is selected; do not silently install a second observer or mix field schemas.

geometryDiagnostics.finding: Incoming adds optional same-evaluation target/dialog rectangles, active animation counts and font status, plus at most18 closed phase records attached to the hover row and logged on original final-target refusal. Original final availability and coordinate assertions are still hard and original error is rethrown. The change adds DOM/API/bookkeeping cost despite adding no CDP call site. It is separable from the requiredContent argument and from the navigation observer replacement; optional metadata failure must remain isolated.

finalStop.finding: Incoming also strengthens final A Stop to join physical absence with exact Team/run/current provisioning/runtime IDs, disconnected progress, visible offline banner and enabled Launch under the existing75s poll. This is an independent extra convergence scope with extra reads. It is not necessary to import BOOT admission or geometry diagnostics and must not enter a narrow merge inadvertently.

testImports.finding: Whole incoming test replacement removes own createHash/fixture-reader imports and all53 ours-only registrations. Keep the own file as the baseline. New incoming helper fixtures often read actual source blocks and depend on additional producers outside these three own files.

helper.observation: The helper computes one30s/60s absolute cutoff, creates controls whose ownership callback also checks that cutoff, optionally performs original beforePreview navigation, and waits for exactly one selector row containing exactly one span whose trimmed text equals TEST boot ready. It checks currentness after that wait, opens through the callback, observes the existing body reply with remaining budget, and checks currentness again.

bootAdmissionComparison.answer: It supplies a same-lead-row exact terminal BOOT preview precondition for the initial opening. It is not equivalent to our continuous required-content target admission and is not a replacement for our saved-settings gate.
differences: Its initial query counts every row matching the selector before target geometry filtering; ours counts unique visible eligible target rows. Both refer to the same selector, not a retained DOM node identity across reads.

Its exact one-span equality rejects a user-prefixed or substring-only marker and duplicate exact spans. Our generic requiredContent check is intentionally textContent.includes(expectedReply), covering both BOOT and stream-partial callers; these are different admission contracts.

After the helper's preview succeeds, scrollTo and click run separate evaluations. Incoming click does not recheck the BOOT text. A row can change content after the preview while retaining selector and geometry; source alone establishes that no content predicate then prevents its press. This is a static uncovered possibility, not an observed historical failure.

Own checks the required reply again in the final expression after the ownership check. The existing revoked-preview test changes content at the sixth ownership call and requires no press/release even at unchanged coordinates.

Incoming helper is used only for initial A/B openings in Selection. Later return to A and reopening the held stream use plain openChat without content. Own keeps expected BOOT or stream-partial literals at all four call sites.

The shared helper adds an explicit preview wait and one cross-operation absolute cutoff; existing controls wait sites remain, but their poll counts and active duration can change. Do not claim call-count/timing equivalence or silently select a new budget interpretation.

incomingBootTests.coverage: Four registered cases contain finite subcases for two lead names; expiration after preview/final-target/reply; missing/pending/wrong-row/user-prefix/substring/duplicate-row/duplicate-span; and lifecycle/runtime/collaboration navigation/budgets. They do not revoke preview content between successful preview and final click. The final case depends on three additional journey source files outside this direct Selection scope.

ownConversationTests.coverage: Actual generated expression and controls with no whole-body readiness substitution; missing/covered/disabled/ambiguous/foreign/empty content controls; escaped literal; pending-read hydration; final content revocation; final ownership/movement refusal; and four real openChat forwarding registrations for BOOT/stream x alice/team-lead.

independentUnits.unit: Shared initial BOOT admission, only if selected
independentUnits.approach: The new helper may provide its exact-span precondition and common absolute cutoff while the opener continues passing the appropriate expectedReply into our existing fourth click argument. Preserve later A/stream call-site requirements. Supplying helper-created controls must be explicit and must not reinterpret the existing second expectedReply argument as a controls object. Keep the saved-settings block untouched.
independentUnits.notAutomatic: The helper is not required merely to replace the same-row hydration behavior already supplied by the own target predicate; its stricter exact-span and shared-budget semantics are additional choices.

independentUnits.unit: Passive geometry facts, only if selected
independentUnits.approach: Port only the isolated geometry projection/phase retention/failure emission around the preserved own target and click path. Keep the fourth argument, our navigation observer, all original sample limits/currentness and final equality refusal. Its three new tests can exercise that isolated behavior after compatibility with our DOM fixtures is reviewed.

Retain all97 own names and assertions. Reuse the44 exact common bodies once. Add only incoming assertions whose corresponding producers are explicitly selected. Do not delete the53 ours-only registrations or replace the pane-schema observer tests to match the flattened incoming schema.

Keep tests exercising the actual composed functions. Our forwarding harness extracts from const openChat to const assertSameLive; incoming moves selector construction into a preceding leadSelector and adds another arrow function. A direct textual transplant would leave that harness without its helper binding. Any future adaptation must retain the actual selector/expectedReply behavior and closure, not weaken the oracle into a marker check.

scopesToKeepSeparate: view-load product diagnostics and silent-refresh behavior
meaningfulFutureChecks: Retain all existing saved-settings25 and conversation19 controls.
If shared BOOT is selected, cover exact-stage rejection and preview becoming stale before final target, with no late press/replay and the selected original absolute cutoff.
Keep initial A/B and return-to-A/stream expected literals explicit.

conclusion: A non-overwriting combination is feasible as separately reviewed hunks, but the incoming helper is only a stronger initial exact-stage precheck; it does not supersede our final per-target content admission or saved-settings readiness. Whole-file incoming replacement loses independent protections and tests.
